limitations: Nearest real Pandar return per approximate Falcon angular cell; not curved raster, noise, wavelength or denser ROI simulation.
Cached inputs already have the original range crop; no unobserved near returns can be recovered.
Original n_raw/n_near metadata retained; raw health statistics are not a complete simulated sensor.
Set F uses the unchanged legacy placement protocol, which depends on the evaluated detector track; no identical-positive-geometry claim.
Ground-truth visibility and injected-point counts remain the original harness denominators; apparent loss can include positive returns removed by the stress transform.
Default-source hash equality does not establish default-input behavior: the external hook changes every processed frame.
Overall STOP loss/addition is not a person-specific true/false-positive count.
Set F stored hit/fp aggregates are reconstructed; complete detections are absent, so assignments cannot be independently rebuilt.
Input-call receipts validate source identities and point counts, not independently stored transformed point payloads; the transform is identified by retained helper/hook hashes and its tests.
The gate's code.commit describes the orchestration checkout. Actual loaded detector identity is the pinned baseline source/source_hashes and hook activation detector_module, not that Git stamp.
Timing is informational under shared load and the recorded priority change.
